context: Sanitize at the logging call sites with the existing sanitize_platform_options - do not invent a logging filter framework. Keep debug usefulness: redact values, keep keys.
description: Found 2026-07-31 during the credential-egress review. benchbox/cli/database.py:425-433 logs extra={'platform_options': platform_options, 'runtime_overrides': runtime_overrides} with the RAW --platform-option values before any sanitization, and :485-488 logs the full built DatabaseConfig plus config.options the same way. DatabaseConfig is extra='allow' (core/schemas.py:340), so password/token ride along as extra fields. These extras are invisible under the CLI's plain formatters but are fully serialized by any structured/JSON handler - including the MCP server's JSONFormatter (benchbox/mcp/observability.py:45-82), which formats record extras into structured logs. Related smaller instance: benchbox/platforms/pyspark/session.py:348 logs the whole session config dict at debug. Fix: route these payloads through sanitize_platform_options (or an equivalent redacting view) before attaching them to log records.
